IGNITE YOUR FULL POTENTIAL

At ITW, you will be trusted and supported to embrace autonomy, make decisions, innovate valued solutions and drive results, providing you with exceptional personal and professional growth opportunities.

Whether you are early in your career or an experienced general manager, there are boundless opportunities across our 80+ global divisions.
"ITW’s decentralized culture has been critical to our success in China. We are empowered to make decisions in our market because we understand the customers."
Helen Hua
Business Unit Manager, ITW Automotive China
"I've had the opportunity to be a part of four different divisions in two different cities, two different segments, three different functions, and the consistency of our culture is a strong thread throughout. I've always felt very supported."
Morgan Manning
Americas Commercial Director, Buehler
"ITW trusts their people and gives them opportunities to grow and develop. That encourages me to grow and strive to excel, and I hope I’m encouraging others to do the same along the way."

BUSINESS SEGMENTS

ITW is a global, multi-industry manufacturing leader with 80+ divisions across seven business segments. We may not be a household name, but our impact is felt everywhere. Our diverse, industry-leading businesses are located across the globe, and our decentralized culture makes it possible to stay curious, develop your skills and learn new responsibilities. 

Learn what differentiates each segment or click below to explore our current openings.
